title: A blueprint for abundance
description: What would it take to meet everyone’s basic needs? A dialogue about labor, incentives and building an open-source path to abundance.
intro: What would it take to secure food, water, shelter and care for everyone? The conversation moves from estimates of necessary work to incentives and a blueprint for building open-source, locally owned infrastructure.

highlights.label: The organizing question
highlights.quote: do you have an easy plan for us to get there that people could follow like you’re pretty smart if people just listened to you do you have a step-by-step plan about what we all could be doing that would be super against our local incentive gradient, but still get us there

highlights.label: Google AI Mode · the blueprint
highlights.quote: The goal is to slowly disconnect our basic survival from the traditional market by building Networked Open-Source Communities.

favorite.label: Google AI Mode · response 6
favorite.quote: This is a strategy of evolutionary obsolescence. You don't fight the old system; you just build a parallel one that is cheaper and more efficient to live in.
